explanation: Athens finished the Parthenon's sculptures in 432 BC. More than 500 years later, the emperor Titus opened the Colosseum in AD 80 with 100 days of games.

claims.text: Work on the Parthenon, including its sculptures, was completed in 432 BC.
The Colosseum was inaugurated by the emperor Titus in AD 80.
Titus opened the Colosseum with games lasting 100 days.
